level.theme: Mysterious and foreboding, with a sense of awe and danger lurking in every shadowed corridor.
level.setting: A vast, ancient underwater ruin filled with shadowy corridors, glowing crystals, and deep, dark trenches. Strange lights flicker from the depths, hinting at something ancient and powerful waiting to be awakened.
level.player_weapon: Geo-Forged Staff (can summon crystalline constructs and manipulate terrain)

encounters.hazard: Current Surge (brief slowdown and stamina drain)

pickup.name: Tectonic Shards
pickup.effect: Tectonic Shards (enhances player's rock-based abilities)

encounters.trigger: Pass through the shadowy trench guarded by the Deepcurrent Warden

encounters.hazard: Maelstrom Whirlpool (brief disorientation and damage over time)

pickup.name: Crystalline Core
pickup.effect: Crystalline Core (allows the player to target weak points in the final boss)

encounters.trigger: Break the corrupted crystal barrier guarded by the Tidal Horror

encounters.hazard: Leviathan's Roar (stuns player and increases enemy damage for a few seconds)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: Trigger the final chamber's alarm by confronting the Leviathan's Guardian

boss.name: The Leviathan's Curse
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan's Curse by using the Crystalline Core to bypass its armor and deal damage to its core.

level.objective: Navigate through the mysterious underwater ruins and defeat the Leviathan's Curse by using the Crystalline Core acquired during the journey.
level.reward: Leviathan's Crown (a powerful relic that enhances geomantic powers)

level.theme: The player, a beastmaster, must protect their aquatic companion and uncover the secrets of the ocean while navigating peaceful but challenging encounters.
level.setting: A serene underwater world filled with bioluminescent coral, drifting kelp, and ancient ruins. Schools of fish glide through the water, and the ocean floor is dotted with glowing sea anemones.

pickup.name: Coral Spikes
pickup.effect: Gain Coral Spikes – a weapon that pierces through scales.

encounters.trigger: Player swims into the dense coral forest, where the Spearfin Tuna is hiding.

pickup.name: Tidal Crystal
pickup.effect: Gain a Tidal Crystal – a glowing gem that amplifies water magic.

encounters.trigger: The player follows a shimmering path in the coral forest into the tidechannel caverns. The Crabclaw Eel lurks in the current.

pickup.name: Leviathan Shell Fragment
pickup.effect: Gain a fragment of the Leviathan’s shell – used to craft a new armor for the beastmaster’s companion.

encounters.trigger: After the Tidal Crystal is used to weaken the Crabclaw Eel, the water glows with strange energy, drawing the player to a hidden lagoon. A massive Leviathan waits there.

boss.name: Leviathan Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan Warden using the Tidal Crystal obtained from the third encounter.

level.objective: Defeat the Leviathan Warden using the Tidal Crystal acquired from the third encounter.
level.reward: Leviathan Shell Armor for your companion, granting +10 armor and +5 stamina.

level.setting: The Abyssal Depths, a submerged ruin in the deep ocean trenches, where the light of the surface world has never touched. The walls pulse with ancient magic and the water is thick with the whispers of the dead.

pickup.name: Soulfire Dagger
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Soulfire Dagger

encounters.trigger: Cross the threshold into the shadowy trench

pickup.name: Cursed Coral Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Cursed Coral Core

encounters.trigger: Trigger the ancient mechanism in the chasm

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: Enter the throne room and activate the Warden's core

level.objective: Navigate through the depths of the Abyss, defeat the wraiths and the abyssal leviathan, and finally confront the Abyssal Warden.

level.theme: Tense, claustrophobic, and atmospheric with ambient sounds of deep-sea creatures and distant thunderstorms
level.setting: Underwater ruins of a sunken civilization, riddled with dangerous currents, toxic plumes, and ancient leviathan remnants
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's Conductor (charges lightning and releases powerful surges)

pickup.name: Coral Shard
pickup.effect: Coral Shard (increases damage against armored enemies)

encounters.trigger: Player activates a dormant storm node, triggering a surge that awakens the Tentacle Serpent

pickup.name: Storm Surge Amplifier
pickup.effect: Storm Surge Amplifier (increases charge damage and duration)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Tentacle Serpent, the player finds the Storm Surge Amplifier, which causes the Kraken Warden to appear in the archive to reclaim it

pickup.name: Leviathan's Core
pickup.effect: Leviathan's Core (damages the boss on contact)

encounters.trigger: The Abyssal Guardian guards the Leviathan's Core. After defeating it, the core is revealed and must be taken to the final chamber to weaken the boss

boss.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
boss.weakness: Coral Shard (acquired in the first encounter)

level.objective: Defeat the Leviathan of the Abyss by navigating through three deadly encounters, acquiring key pickups, and using them strategically against the final boss
level.reward: Leviathan's Heart (permanent damage boost and storm power upgrade)

level.theme: Eerie and mysterious, with the atmosphere thick with the feeling of being watched and the ever-present threat of the unknown.
level.setting: A vast, uncharted underwater trench filled with ancient ruins, glowing bioluminescent flora, and dark, swirling currents.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade (dagger with stealth and critical strike capabilities)

enemy.name: Gloomfin
enemy.weakness: Gloomfin is weak to the corrosive mist you collected from the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: A faint bioluminescent mist fills the chamber, making vision difficult.

pickup.name: Corrosive Mist
pickup.effect: You collect a vial of corrosive mist that can damage organic enemies.

encounters.trigger: As you move deeper into the cavern, a sudden tremor reveals a hidden passage leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Deep Diver
enemy.weakness: The Deep Diver is weak to the corrosive mist you acquired in the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: Pressure from the deep causes the ocean floor to shift unpredictably.

pickup.name: Shattered Obsidian Blade
pickup.effect: You find a powerful weapon: the Shattered Obsidian Blade, glowing with ancient energy.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Deep Diver, a fissure in the trench opens, revealing a path to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Abyssal Warden (Mini-Boss)
enemy.weakness: The Abyssal Warden is vulnerable to the Shattered Obsidian Blade, which you obtained after defeating the Deep Diver.

encounters.hazard: The water becomes dense with dark energy, slowing your movement and causing hallucinations.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: As you enter the chamber, the Abyssal Warden rises from the darkness, ready to defend its domain.

boss.name: The Abyssal Warden
boss.weakness: The Abyssal Warden is vulnerable to the Shattered Obsidian Blade, a weapon you acquired after defeating the Deep Diver.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Abyssal Warden using the Shattered Obsidian Blade.

level.objective: Navigate through the underwater ruins, defeat three enemies, and finally defeat the Abyssal Warden using the weapon you earned during the journey.
level.reward: Unlocks the Abyssal Relic, granting increased stealth and energy regeneration in underwater environments.

level.theme: Chaos and destruction under the sea, with fire and molten fury as the player's allies and enemies alike.
level.setting: A chaotic underwater city of molten ruins, where lava vents, gas bubbles, and explosive hazards make navigation and combat extremely dangerous.

pickup.name: Inferno Flame
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the thermal vent

pickup.name: Inferno Core Extractor
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Inferno Core Extractor

encounters.trigger: Player activates the thermal vent's core

pickup.name: Core Resonator
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and mana

encounters.trigger: Player activates the Inferno Core Extractor

boss.name: Kraken of the Abyss
boss.weakness: The Inferno Core Extractor (acquired during the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Kraken's core with the Inferno Core Extractor

level.objective: Destroy the Kraken of the Abyss by reaching its core through three deadly encounters.

level.theme: Abandoned research facilities and deep ocean trench exploration.
level.setting: Desolate underwater ruins filled with decaying technology and mutated lifeforms.

enemy.name: Drone Scavenger
enemy.weakness: The Drone Scavenger is weak to electrical attacks, which can be obtained from the 'Electro Capacitor' pickup found during the encounter.

pickup.name: Electro Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases player's electro damage by 30% for 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the substation to investigate a signal.

enemy.name: Biomechanical Warden
enemy.weakness: The Biomechanical Warden is weak to the 'Severed Chain' weapon, which must be acquired from the first encounter.

pickup.name: Severed Chain
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health and provides a temporary shield.

encounters.trigger: Player follows a trail of debris from the substation to the research lab.

enemy.name: Mutated Leviathan
enemy.weakness: The Mutated Leviathan is weak to the 'Electro Capacitor' pickup, which was found in the first encounter.

pickup.name: Leviathan Core
pickup.effect: Increases player's armor by 20% for 90 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player explores the vault after defeating the Mutated Leviathan, leading to the final confrontation.

boss.name: Leviathan's Warden
boss.weakness: The Leviathan's Warden is vulnerable to the 'Severed Chain' weapon, which was obtained from the first encounter.

level.objective: Survive the desolate underwater ruins and defeat the Leviathan's Warden.

level.theme: A dreamlike, surreal underwater journey through magical coral gardens and enchanted grottos, where the player must use illusion to survive and progress.
level.setting: A whimsical underwater world filled with glowing coral, floating bubbles, and reflective caverns. The ocean is alive with strange and playful creatures, and the water shimmers with an otherworldly glow.

enemy.name: Bubble Blob
enemy.weakness: The Bubble Blob is vulnerable to sound waves. Use the Echo Waker, found in the treasure chest after defeating it.

encounters.hazard: A field of floating bubbles that slow movement

pickup.name: Echo Waker
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Echo Waker

encounters.trigger: Player enters the coral garden after navigating through the kelp maze

enemy.name: Mirror Eel
enemy.weakness: The Mirror Eel is vulnerable to illusions. Use the Echo Waker to create a decoy and distract it.

encounters.hazard: Reflective water surfaces that distort vision

pickup.name: Light Lens
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Light Lens

encounters.trigger: Player follows the glowing light from the Echo Waker to the Mirror Caverns

enemy.name: Shimmerfin
enemy.weakness: The Shimmerfin is vulnerable to light. Use the Light Lens to blind it and strike

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and shifting shadows that make it hard to track the enemy

pickup.name: Light Lens
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Light Lens

encounters.trigger: Player follows the light from the Mirror Caverns to the Glimmer Grotto

boss.name: The Octo-Mimic
boss.weakness: The mimic is vulnerable to light. The Light Lens, collected in the previous encounter, is the only weapon that can damage it.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the mimic's core by using the Light Lens

level.objective: Defeat The Octo-Mimic by using the Light Lens, which was obtained by defeating the Shimmerfin and unlocking the power in the Glimmer Grotto
level.reward: Unlock the 'Whimsical Dive' achievement and gain 1000 XP

pickup.name: Serpent's Heart
pickup.effect: Restores 25% Health

encounters.trigger: Player enters the cavern

pickup.name: Obsidian Fang
pickup.effect: Increases Beastmaster's pet damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the edge of the swamp

pickup.name: Guardian's Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary shield against elemental damage

encounters.trigger: Player enters the hollow after defeating the guardian

level.theme: Mysterious jungle with hidden dangers and ancient secrets, where the ranger must use wit and strength to navigate and survive.
level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle where the sun rarely shines, and the air is thick with mystery and ancient magic.

pickup.name: Jungle Bloom
pickup.effect: Fog of Mist dissipates, revealing hidden paths and traps.

encounters.trigger: The fog thickens, revealing a hidden shadow viper coiled around a tree.

pickup.name: Ranger's Bow
pickup.effect: Bramble Snare is released, allowing passage.

encounters.trigger: A rustling in the undergrowth reveals a Cursed Hunter, brandishing a blackened blade.

pickup.name: Echoing Stone
pickup.effect: Echoing Steps cease, revealing the path forward.

encounters.trigger: A mimic resembling a fallen warrior emerges, its eyes glowing with unnatural light.

boss.name: Shadow Jaguar
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Shadow Jaguar by exploiting the Jungle Bloom's effect on its shadow form.

level.objective: Survive through the jungle, uncovering its secrets and defeating the Shadow Jaguar, the guardian of the jungle's heart.
level.reward: Shadow Jaguar's Eye (increases critical hit chance by 10%)

level.theme: Tense jungle survival with high-stakes encounters where each step could be the last.
level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with mist, hidden traps, and hostile creatures. The air is thick with tension and the distant roars of unseen predators.

pickup.name: Serrated Dagger
pickup.effect: Acquire 'Serrated Dagger' (player's weapon)

encounters.trigger: Cross the toxic vines to continue deeper into the jungle.

pickup.name: Stamina Potion
pickup.effect: Acquire 'Stamina Potion'

encounters.trigger: Navigate the bog to reach the ruins ahead.

pickup.name: Obsidian Vial
pickup.effect: Acquire 'Obsidian Vial'

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Shaman to reveal the Jaguar Warden's lair.

boss.name: The Jaguar Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jaguar Warden by exploiting his weakness: the Obsidian Vial found in the third encounter.

level.objective: Navigate through the jungle and defeat the Jaguar Warden by exploiting weaknesses found in prior encounters.
level.reward: Access to the sacred temple, a rare artifact called the 'Jungle Heart' (increases player health by 30).

level.setting: A tranquil jungle filled with bioluminescent plants, ancient ruins, and calm waterfalls.

pickup.name: Tactical Net
pickup.effect: Gain 'Tactical Net' item.

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the edge of the glade where vines begin to entangle the path.

pickup.name: Thornclaw Dagger
pickup.effect: Gain 'Thornclaw Dagger' item.

encounters.trigger: Player uses 'Tactical Net' to subdue Mossclaw, and the vines part to reveal a hidden path.

pickup.name: Vine Cutter
pickup.effect: Gain 'Vine Cutter' item.

encounters.trigger: Player defeats Tangleroot with 'Thornclaw Dagger,' causing the ruins to shift and reveal the final path to the boss.

boss.name: Vinebound Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the 'Vine Cutter' item obtained from the third encounter.

level.objective: Reach the center of the jungle and defeat the Vinebound Warden.
level.reward: Vinebound Warden's Sash (increases defense by 10 points).

level.setting: A dense, mist-shrouded jungle filled with decaying ruins, ghostly apparitions, and corrupted wildlife. The air is thick with the scent of decay and the sound of distant howls.

pickup.name: Bloodstone Dagger
pickup.effect: Bloodstone Dagger (increases damage by 25% for 60 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the First Warden causes the ground to crack and a blood-soaked symbol to appear, summoning the next enemy.

pickup.name: Ancient Totem
pickup.effect: Ancient Totem (reduces enemy damage by 15% for 45 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ghost Serpent causes the totem to glow and summon the final enemy.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: The Ancient Totem activates and reveals the Hollow Jaguar's weakness, preparing for the final confrontation.

boss.name: The Hollow Jaguar
boss.weakness: Bloodstone Dagger (acquired from the First Warden encounter)

level.objective: Survive the jungle, defeat all enemies, and defeat the Hollow Jaguar.

level.setting: A whimsical, magical jungle teeming with talking flora, mischievous creatures, and ancient, sentient plants. The air is thick with pollen, and the ground hums with unseen magic.

pickup.name: Whispering Seed
pickup.effect: You find a glowing seed. It whispers to you.

encounters.trigger: You hear a laugh echoing from the canopy. A Giggling Gecko appears, amused by your presence.

pickup.name: Alchemical Flame Spray
pickup.effect: A glowing flask falls from the sky. It contains a volatile mixture of fire and acid.

encounters.trigger: You step into a fog. The mist thickens, and the ivy around you begins to pulse. A living mass of poison ivy rises from the ground.

pickup.name: Whispering Seed
pickup.effect: You find a glowing seed. It whispers to you.

encounters.trigger: You arrive at the center of the jungle, where the vines entwine into a massive, writhing beast. The Tanglebeast has been waiting for you.

boss.name: The Tanglebeast
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Tanglebeast by using the Whispering Seed to break its magic vines.

level.objective: Survive the jungle, defeat the creatures that guard it, and claim the heart of the wild with your alchemy.
level.reward: The jungle grants you a new alchemical recipe: 'Vinebreaker Elixir'—a potion that can shatter even the strongest magic vines.

level.theme: Eerie Jungle: A realm where time is fractured, and the past and future bleed into the present.
level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with strange ruins, glowing flora, and time-warped phenomena. The air is thick with the scent of decay and the sound of distant, unnatural echoes.

encounters.hazard: Time Distortion (slows the player by 50% for 3 seconds)

pickup.name: The Hourglass Shard
pickup.effect: The player finds a fractured shard of an ancient hourglass. It glows faintly with unstable time energy.

encounters.trigger: The player enters the jungle and notices a strange distortion in the air. A vulture with glowing eyes swoops down, attacking with time-slowing claws.

encounters.hazard: ECHO (copies the player's actions and attacks them with delayed precision)

pickup.name: Temporal Runestone
pickup.effect: The player uncovers a glowing runestone that pulses with energy, allowing them to manipulate small pockets of time.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the vulture, the player enters a stone circle surrounded by ancient monoliths. The ground begins to crack and an Echoed Guardian materializes, mimicking the player's movements.

encounters.hazard: Time Loop (repeats the last 10 seconds of combat indefinitely until the player escapes with a timed ability)

pickup.name: The Temporal Key
pickup.effect: The player discovers the key to the temple's inner chamber—an ancient lock that only responds to time magic.

encounters.trigger: After escaping the Echoed Guardian's loop, the player finds a hidden door leading to the temple. The Warden, a spectral figure bound to time, blocks the way, wielding a weapon that warps the flow of time around it.

boss.name: The Timekeeper of the Ruins
boss.weakness: The Hourglass Shard (acquired in the first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Timekeeper of the Ruins

level.objective: Defeat the final boss: The Timekeeper of the Ruins
level.reward: The player gains access to the Timekeeper’s Core, a powerful artifact that allows them to rewind time in short bursts, and a new ability called 'Temporal Anchor' that prevents enemies from using time-based abilities against them.

level.setting: A desolate jungle, overgrown with dead trees and corrupted flora, haunted by ancient spirits and beastly foes.

pickup.name: Ancient Jaguar Talisman
pickup.effect: Player gains the Ancient Jaguar Talisman (used to weaken the boss)

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the heart of the ruins, triggering a spectral ambush.

enemy.name: Poisoned Tengu
enemy.weakness: Ancient Jaguar Talisman (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Vines Entangle (reduces player movement speed by 50% for 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Serrated Bone Axe
pickup.effect: Player gains the Serrated Bone Axe (increased damage with this weapon)

encounters.trigger: After escaping the Wraith, the player stumbles into a grove of thorned trees, where the Tengu attacks.

enemy.name: The Hollow Jaguar (mini-boss)
enemy.weakness: Ancient Jaguar Talisman (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Cursed Spirit (deals 10% of player's max health as damage every 3 seconds)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Tengu, the player reaches the Jaguar's Roost, where the Hollow Jaguar awaits.

boss.name: The Hollow Jaguar
boss.weakness: Ancient Jaguar Talisman (obtained from the first encounter)

level.objective: Survive the desolate jungle and defeat The Hollow Jaguar.
level.reward: Ancient Jaguar Totem (grants +25% damage against jungle enemies for 10 minutes)
